Name: Lost My Pants (Nude Mod)
Author: TrashRacc1124
Description:
[center][u][b][size=4]About:[/size][/b][/u]
________________________________________________________________

Tired of running around in the same old undershirt and polka dot shorts? Well, with this mod you can now pull a mayor Lewis and loose those pants! 

[b]This mod allows the player to become fully nude when removing any clothing item.
Also allows the player to censor their bits with an optional Leaf.[/b]

Why, you may ask? Well, I got bored...
But seriously, I wanted to make a mod that adds a little more realism to the Stardew Valley world by breaking a few boundaries for a better sense of freedom.
I know there are a few mods like this out there, however, many seem to either be outdated, non-compatible or buggy. I wanted this mod to fix those issues so everyone can enjoy!
Its entirely up to you how you would like to interpret this mod.

[size=4][u][b]Content
[/b][/u][/size]________________________________________________________________

- [color=#e06666][b]Removes[/b][/color] the white under shirt and red polka dot pants
- [b][color=#e06666]Removes[/color][/b] swimsuit when bathing
-[color=#6aa84f] [b]Adds[/b][/color] PP for the male characters 
- [color=#6aa84f][b]Adds[/b][/color] BB's for the female characters 
- [color=#6aa84f][b]Adds[/b][/color] an optional censor Leaf to cover the bits
- Censor Leaf can be turned on/off through [b][color=#6d9eeb]config[/color][/b]
- Skin tone can be adjusted through [b][color=#6d9eeb]config[/color]
[/b]
[size=4][u][b]Installation
[/b][/u][/size]________________________________________________________________

This mod requires the latest version of [url=http://https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] & [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher

[/url]I also recommend downloading [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ (Optional)

1. Download the Mod and extract it
2. Paste it into your [b]\Stardew Valley\mods\[/b] folder﻿﻿﻿
3. Run the game and enjoy

[b]Optional[/b]
4. Adjust the config to your preference by 
A) Editing the config.json 
[b]or[/b]
B) By using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Optional)

[size=4][b][u]Compatibility
[/u][/b][/size]﻿________________________________________________________________

Should be compatible with most lewd mods (Except for LewdDew Valley since the player assets clash)
 [color=#93c47d][b]- Mods that add or change clothing (shirts/pants) should hopefully be compatible[/b][/color]
